result.topic_en: The page finishes a reformulation of a theorem on sums of greatest-integer brackets $[fa/4n + 1/2] - [fa/4n]$, then begins 'Third proof of the fundamental theorem on quadratic residues in a new form', defining sets of residues for odd numbers m, M and their product μ.

items.english: The theorem can therefore also be expressed thus: the sum of all [f'a/4n + 1/2] - [f'a/4n], where f' denotes all odd numbers up to n inclusive, equals twice the sum of all [ga/4n + 1/2] - [ga/4n + 1/4], where g denotes all numbers up to n/2, except that for g = n/2 only half the value must be counted.
